title: Rethinking "RL Generalizes, SFT Memorizes": The Role of SFT Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.14912v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models trained with Reinforcement Learning (RL) with verifiable rewards exhibit strong reasoning ability and broad generalization, whereas models trained with Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) are often viewed as more prone to memorization and limited transfer. This paper rethinks this distinction through the lens of SFT training data on widely used Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 series models. First, we study the role of data source and show that it is critical: a carefully mixed SFT dataset substantially outperforms data generated solely by a larger model. Second, we study the role of data scale and show that matching the number of correct rollouts between SFT and RL greatly improves SFT generalization, while matching the total rollout budget enables SFT to generalize as well as RL. translated_title: 重新思考“RL泛化，SFT记忆”：SFT数据的作用
translated_abstract: 使用可验证奖励的强化学习（RL）训练的大语言模型展现出强大的推理能力和广泛的泛化能力，而通过监督微调（SFT）训练的模型通常被认为更容易产生记忆化且迁移能力有限。本文在广泛使用的Qwen2.5和Qwen3系列模型上，从SFT训练数据的视角重新审视了这一区别。首先，我们研究了数据来源的作用，并证明其至关重要：精心混合的SFT数据集显著优于仅由更大模型生成的数据。其次，我们研究了数据规模的作用，结果表明使SFT与RL的正确rollout数量相匹配可大幅提升SFT的泛化能力，而匹配总rollout预算则能使SFT的泛化能力与RL相当。将这两个因素相结合，可进一步使SFT的泛化能力甚至超越RL。第三，通过使用LLM标注来刻画解法方法……（摘要不完整）
tldr: SFT泛化不佳并非模型固有缺陷而是数据问题——精心混合数据来源并匹配RL的正确采样数量或总采样预算，可使SFT的泛化能力追平甚至超过RL。
en_tdlr: The "RL generalizes, SFT memorizes" gap mainly stems from SFT data choices: carefully mixing data sources and matching data scale to RL's rollouts enables SFT to generalize as well as or even better than RL.
